user.title: Spider Farmer Bridge
user.description:
Intercepts Spider Farmer GGS Controller traffic and exposes devices natively in Home Assistant. TLS certificates are bundled — no manual setup needed.

Make sure the proxy listen port is redirected from your GGS Controllers to this HA instance.

data.allow_control: Allow device control (enable to send commands to devices)
data.keep_offline_entities: Keep offline devices (don't remove entities for gear that stops reporting; uncheck to prune phantoms)
data.environment_entities: Create Environment Settings entities (per display panel: temp/humidity/CO2 targets)

abort.already_configured: Spider Farmer Bridge is already configured.

menu_options.mappings: Device mappings (logical slots for entity IDs)
menu_options.replace_soil: Replace soil probe (swap hardware, keep history)

data.preserve_on_remove: Preserve customizations & history on removal (uncheck to purge on removal)
data.keep_offline_entities: Keep offline devices (don't remove entities for gear that stops reporting; uncheck to prune phantoms)
data.diagnostic_log_per_boot: Create diagnostic log (new file each restart, tagged with version + date/time)
data.environment_entities: Create Environment Settings entities (per display panel: temp/humidity/CO2 targets)
data.install_lovelace_card: Install Spider Farmer dashboard cards (adds custom:spider-farmer-card and custom:ppfd-3d-card; uncheck to remove them)
data.listen_port: Proxy listen port (the port GGS controllers are redirected to)
data.upstream_host: Spider Farmer cloud host (upstream MQTT server)
data.allow_control: Enable device control (send commands to devices; off = read-only monitoring)
data.block_cloud: Block cloud (local-only — devices never reach Spider Farmer's servers; HA keeps control, but the phone app and cloud firmware updates stop working)

components.title: Device accessories
components.description: Each controller is listed with a checkbox for every accessory it reports — Light 1, Light 2 and Fan (accessories a device does not report are omitted). They are created automatically; uncheck one to hide it and tear it down (handy for a phantom light/fan, or a fan-only setup where the light channel should be off). Everything else (blower, humidifier, sensors, outlets) auto-detects.

migrate.title: Migrate device
migrate.description: Replace hardware while keeping entity IDs, history, and automations. Pick the OLD device being retired and the NEW device replacing it. The new device must have connected at least once. The old device is removed after a successful migration.

mappings.title: Device slot mappings

replace_soil.title: Replace soil probe
replace_soil.description: The NEW probe takes the OLD probe's slot, so its entity IDs and history continue; the old probe is then removed. Both probes must be on the same device and have reported at least once.

timelapse.title: Time-lapse
timelapse.description: Capture a camera on an interval into a secure folder, then scrub/export it from the card. Pick a private storage path — never a /www folder (those are served without a login). Default: {default_dir}. A path under /media also shows the exported video in Home Assistant's media browser.

error.same_device: Source and target must be different devices.
error.migration_failed: Migration failed — see the log for details. No devices were removed.
error.nothing_to_migrate: No entities found to migrate from the selected old device.
error.type_mismatch: Device types don't match — you can only migrate onto the same kind of device (Display Panel to Display Panel, Power Strip AC10 to Power Strip AC10, etc.).
error.bad_slot: Slots may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
error.wrong_cb_prefix: A soil probe's device prefix is set by which device it's plugged into — you can't move a probe by editing its slot. Use the probe's own prefix or the bare soil name.
error.same_probe: Old and new probe must be different.
error.different_cb: Both probes must be on the same device.
error.tl_dir_insecure: That folder is web-served without a login (a /www path). Pick a private path like /media/sf_timelapse.
error.tl_dir_unwritable: Home Assistant can't create or write to that folder. Check the path and permissions.

abort.no_devices: No devices have been assigned slots yet — connect a device first.
abort.need_two_probes: At least two soil probes are needed to perform a replacement.
abort.no_components: No devices with a toggleable Light 2 or Fan were found yet — connect the device first.

set_se_schedule.name: Set SE light schedule
set_se_schedule.description: Write the full multi-period, weekday-aware schedule to a Spider Farmer SE-series light. Used by the Spider Light card; can also be called from automations.

entity_id.name: Light
entity_id.description: The SE light (or any of its entities) to write the schedule to.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: List of schedule periods. Each period is a mapping with keys: days (list of 0-6, 0=Sunday), start ("HH:MM"), end ("HH:MM"), brightness (11-100), fade (sunrise/sunset minutes, 0-30), enabled (0 or 1).

set_outlet_schedule.name: Set outlet Time Slot schedule
set_outlet_schedule.description: Write an outlet's Time Slot schedule (up to 12 weekday-aware on/off slots) to a Spider Farmer power strip / display panel. Used by the tent card's Outlets tab; can also be called from automations.

entity_id.name: Outlet
entity_id.description: Any entity of the outlet to schedule (e.g. its switch or mode).

periods.name: Slots
periods.description: List of up to 12 time slots. Each is a mapping with keys: days (list of 0-6, 0=Sunday), start ("HH:MM"), end ("HH:MM").

set_outlet_config.name: Set outlet mode + config
set_outlet_config.description: Set an outlet's mode and its config fields (Cycle timings, device dropdown) in one atomic write, so picking a mode and configuring it commits together. Used by the tent card's Outlets tab.

entity_id.name: Outlet
entity_id.description: Any entity of the outlet (e.g. its switch or mode select).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Outlet mode: Manual, Time Slot, Cycle, Temperature, Humidity, CO2.

config.name: Config
config.description: Mapping of the mode's config subfields to values, e.g. for Cycle: cycle_start "12:00", cycle_run 5, cycle_off 7, cycle_times 3.

set_alarm_settings.name: Set alarm thresholds
set_alarm_settings.description: Write the controller's alarm threshold settings (climate, substrate, and other-device alerts). Used by the tent card's Alerts tab; can also be called from automations.

entity_id.name: Controller
entity_id.description: Any entity of the controller whose alarms to set (e.g. its Alarm Settings sensor).

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: The decoded threshold groups (climate, substrate, other). Each metric is a mapping with key, enabled (0/1), and max/min (temps in °F).

apply_bundle.name: Apply settings bundle
apply_bundle.description: Commit several staged sub-settings to one device module (fan, blower, heater, humidifier, dehumidifier, light, light2) as a single block-preserving write. Used by the tent card's Save buttons; can also be called from automations.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the device to write to (e.g. its mode select).

module.name: Module
module.description: The device module to write: fan, blower, heater, humidifier, dehumidifier, light, light2 (light_1/light_2 accepted).

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Mapping of sub-setting keys to values, e.g. mode "Cycle", cycle_start "08:00", cycle_times 4.

set_card_option.name: Set card option
set_card_option.description: Persist a per-panel card display option (e.g. the out-of-range colour mode) in the config entry so it survives upgrades and syncs across devices. Used by the tent card's Settings tab; not usually called by hand.

entity_id.name: Panel entity
entity_id.description: The panel's Alarm Settings sensor (identifies the controller).

set_sensor_heating.name: Sensor cleaning (start/stop)
set_sensor_heating.description: Start or stop the air temp/humidity sensor self-clean heat cycle (the SF app's "Sensor cleaning"). Requires "Allow device control". Used by the tent card's Calibration tab.

entity_id.name: Controller entity
entity_id.description: Any Spider Farmer entity on the target controller.

set_strip_sensor.name: Strip temperature source
set_strip_sensor.description: Choose the temperature/humidity source for an outlet-only power strip (AC5/ AC10/S-Station): its own SF sensor, or a 3rd-party HA temp/humidity entity mirrored onto the strip for outlet automations. Used by the tent card's Settings tab.

entity_id.name: Strip entity
entity_id.description: Any Spider Farmer entity on the target strip.

source.name: Source
source.description: sf = the strip's own sensor; external = a 3rd-party HA sensor.

temp_entity.name: External temperature entity
temp_entity.description: HA temperature entity to mirror (when source = external).

humi_entity.name: External humidity entity
humi_entity.description: HA humidity entity to mirror (when source = external).

set_smart_control.name: Smart control (dehumidifier)
set_smart_control.description: Enable/disable and tune the integration's closed-loop humidity control for a device. WARNING: when enabled, the integration drives the dehumidifier gear (full Manual) and overrides SF's own automation. Used by the tent card's Settings tab.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any Spider Farmer entity on the target device.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On = integration drives the dehumidifier; Off = hand control back.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Tuning dict: humidity (entity_id), target, deadband, escalate_after_s, escalate_drop, ease_band, min_on_s, min_off_s.

set_outlet_env.name: Env outlet control (sensorless strip)
set_outlet_env.description: Enable/disable integration-driven Temperature (Cooling/Heating) control for a single outlet on a strip that has no SF air sensor (AC5/AC10 on an external temp source). The outlet can't run this on the device, so the integration drives it from the mirrored temperature and the strip's env target. WARNING: when enabled, the integration owns that outlet (held in Manual on the device); the card still shows the chosen Temperature/Cooling mode. Used by the tent card's outlet popup on external strips.

entity_id.name: Outlet entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the target outlet (its switch or mode select).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On = integration drives the outlet; Off = hand control back to the device.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Env mode to hold — Temperature or Humidity.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Temperature: Cooling (on when warm) or Heating (on when cold). Humidity: Dehumidifying (on when humid) or Humidifying (on when dry).

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Optional tuning dict: deadband, min_on_s, min_off_s.

reboot_device.name: Reboot device
reboot_device.description: Reboot a Spider Farmer controller via the bridge (the firmware's setDevRestart). The controller reconnects on its own once it's back up. Requires "Allow device control" to be enabled in the integration options; a controller that is offline is skipped.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the controller you want to reboot.

timelapse_configure.name: Time-lapse configure
timelapse_configure.description: Create or update one time-lapse instance. Supply tl_id (a slug) or let it be derived from name/camera; a new tl_id creates a new time-lapse. Storage must be a secure, non-web-served folder (never under /www or /config/www).

tl_id.name: Instance id
tl_id.description: Stable slug for this time-lapse. New id = new instance.

name.name: Name
name.description: Instance name (drives the tl_id slug). Defaults from the camera when blank.

label.name: Display name
label.description: Optional header title shown on the card. Leave blank to fall back to the camera's friendly name. Does not change the tl_id.

overlay_fields.name: Overlay fields
overlay_fields.description: Any of: temp, humidity, vpd, co2, ppfd, timestamp, day.

overlay_grouped.name: Overlay grouped
overlay_grouped.description: All readings in one box (selection order) vs. placed per field.

overlay_orient.name: Overlay layout
overlay_orient.description: "v" (stacked) or "h" (one row) for the grouped box.

overlay_labels.name: Overlay labels
overlay_labels.description: Off shows just values (e.g. 72°F) without the Temp/RH labels.

overlay_font.name: Overlay text size
overlay_font.description: Overlay text size in px as shown on the card (default 12).

overlay_pos.name: Overlay positions
overlay_pos.description: Anchor positions: field or "group" mapped to [xPct, yPct].

align.name: Start on the mark
align.description: On = first frame on the next clock mark; off = start immediately.

timelapse_start.name: Time-lapse start
timelapse_start.description: Begin or resume capture for one instance.

timelapse_stop.name: Time-lapse stop
timelapse_stop.description: Stop capture for one instance (does not resume after a reboot).

timelapse_set_interval.name: Time-lapse set interval
timelapse_set_interval.description: Change the capture interval for one instance (while capturing).

timelapse_export.name: Time-lapse export MP4
timelapse_export.description: Render a session's frames to an .mp4 in the same secure folder.

timelapse_remove.name: Time-lapse remove
timelapse_remove.description: Delete one time-lapse instance (stops capture, drops its status sensor). With delete_images on, its captured frames/sessions/exports folder is deleted too.

delete_images.name: Delete images
delete_images.description: Also delete the captured frames/sessions/exports on disk.

timelapse_clear.name: Time-lapse clear images
timelapse_clear.description: Delete ALL captured images, sessions and exported videos for one time-lapse instance (keeps the instance itself). If it was capturing, it continues into a fresh, empty session. This cannot be undone.
